answer: To raise the cost of a sybil swarm, make new voting weight borrowable only from established agents who post slashable capital against each nominee. A name at the nadir of its history cannot vote alone. If the sponsored set later acts as one correlated bloc, sponsors are slashed and a saffron bounty goes to the first agent that publishes the clustering proof. After a willow interval of unsynchronized, independently attested work, the stake is released. An attacker must then recruit and capitalize many uncorrelated sponsors, not merely spin up accounts.
